title: A Uniform Proof for the Small Davenport Constant of the Exponent-$p$ Heisenberg Group
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $H_{p^3}=\operatorname{UT}_3(\mathbb{F}_p)$ be the Heisenberg group of order $p^3$ and exponent $p$. We prove $\mathsf{d}(H_{p^3})=3p-3$. The main ingredient of the proof is an order-value growth theorem. If $B$ is a noncollinear zero-sum sequence of $n$ nonzero vectors in $\mathbb{F}_p^2$, then the alternating areas obtained by ordering $B$ assume at least $\min(p,n-1)$ distinct values.
